entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Visual Studio] [C# 14] Private extension methods incorrectly marked as unused members #81657
  • Extension property incorrectly resolved to same named static method #81656
  • notnull constraint works in VS2022 but not in VS2026 #81654
  • intellisense in VB.net is broken #81653
    Backlog

Closed

  • Interactive Windows need a shortcut keys... #3941
    Backlog
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/features/dictionary-expressions` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #81639
  • Fatal VS crash when invoking completion session #81576
    18.3
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.stackAnalysis-11310.114 #81647

PullRequests

Created

  • LSP: Tolerate non-mutating requests where we are unable to determine the language #81660
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Add Ctrl+Alt+C keyboard shortcut to Open C# Interactive Window command #81659
  • [DRAFT] Rename - add conflicting member name message #81658
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve error recovery around modifiers in a declaration-expression. #81655
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Initial support for Unions conversions #81586
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Add collection expression 'with(...)' test #81652
    Area-Compilers, Test, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Ref-safety for `with(...)` elements. #81542
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Reduce allocations in PENamedTypeSymbol.GetMemberTypesPrivate #81605
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Replace "newExtension" term in declaration names with "ExtensionBlock" #81651
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Remove LookupOptions.IncludeExtensionMembers #81650
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Remove smart rename lightup #81598
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Ensure binder with `BinderFlags.AttributeArgument` is in the local binder chain #81628
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Configure 17.11 to pull from 17.10 VS opt prof #81646

Updated

  • Extension indexers: allow and resolve extension indexers #81607
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add specific error for extension parameter usage in static members #81606
    Area-IDE
  • Improve error recovery in top level statements #81604
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • *** WIP -- DeclarationTable allocation reductions #81627
    Area-Compilers
  • Simplify parsing of variable declarators. #81454
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Improve location of error diagnostic when encountering errant operator token #81295
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error recovery around 'scoped' modifier parsing #81636
    Area-Compilers
  • Unsafe evolution: check caller unsafe context for usages of some methods and properties #81581
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81626
  • Make scripting work in single-file deployments #57910
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Track sourceLink and resources in deterministic key #81629
    Area-Compilers, Concept-Determinism
